trust: Definitions inspected and trusted via normal native /hooks UI in a disposable Codex home. Trusted checker outside model write scope. No global installation.
limits: Direct native Bash path only; not nested code, apply_patch, MCP or every write path.
Cancellation, exhaustion, missing-checker handling and stale artifacts have protocol tests, not complete native runtime coverage.
T3 tool surface exposes delegation but no arbitrary hook registration; native CLI evidence does not prove T3 enforcement.
A crashing hook can fail open. Validate the complete installed bundle before relying on it.
A hook enforces only its trusted checker contract, not arbitrary intent, taste or universal correctness.
